## 2. Boot flow

### 2.1 Timeline frames (`Main.as`)

`Main` is the document class: `[SWF(width="550", height="450", backgroundColor="#142b2c", frameRate="50")]`
(Main.as:25). `addFrameScript(0,this.frame1,1,this.frame2)` (Main.as:221).

| Frame | Script | Effect |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | `frame1()` | `stop();` then `try { _-0o.track(this, _-Nz."54a439e7") } catch` — MochiAd-style tracker with XTEA-decoded id `54a439e7` (Main.as:606-616) |
| 2 | `frame2()` | `gotoAndStop("main")` (Main.as:527-530). Frame labels (DefineSceneAndFrameLabelData in dumpswf.txt:4): `"main"` = frame 1, `"load"` = frame 2. Note for the port: because frame 2's own script jumps back to `"main"`, every `gotoAndStop("load")` (preloader `_ -07`/`Setup`) effectively ends parked on frame 1 — the `"load"` label is cosmetic; the preloader/continue button are dynamic `addChild` objects, not timeline content |

### 2.2 Constructor setup relevant to UI (Main.as:205-386)

- Context menu: built-in items hidden; two custom items —
  `"Made by Hero Interactive"` → `URL_OPEN(2)` (herointeractive.com), `"Sponsored by Armor Games"` →
  `URL_OPEN(1)` (armorgames.com) (Main.as:214-216, 280-285, 830-833, 1398-1401).
- SharedObjects: `sharedObj = SharedObject.getLocal("BTA")`, `Player1Profile = SharedObject.getLocal("Player1Profile")` (Main.as:276-277).
- Portal detection via `_ -E` (domain checker, `_ -E.as`): `_ -Fs` ∈ `kongregate` (kongregate.com / kongregatetrunk.com / andkon.com), `armorgames`, `herointeractive`, `candystand`, `newgrounds` (Main.as:318-337).
- Newgrounds (only on newgrounds.com): `API.connect(loaderInfo, "16769:BQgibgGv", "NsPJ32FV1418TB5C7z0VQKhbkFHMwRvq")`, otherwise `removeChild(medal_popup)` (Main.as:338-345).
- Kongregate: loads `parameters.kongregate_api_path` (default `http://www.kongregate.com/flash/API_AS3_Local.swf`), on complete `kongregate.services.connect()` (Main.as:346-356, 1002-1009).
- Defaults: `mainFPS = gData.mainFPS2` (50), `_ -FF = 0`, `blnScreenShake = true`, `_ -cw` (music) = true, `_ -Qg` (sounds) = true, `intEnemyCountMaster = 10000001` (Main.as:286-292).
- Domain lists from GameData: allow `_ -Y9` [herointeractive.com, armorgames.com], ad-free `_ -8h`
  [addictinggames.com, agstage.shockwave.com, freeonlinegames.com, andkon.com, kongregate.com,
  kongregatetrunk.com, gamezhero.com, armorgames.com], EC-unlock `_ -KA` [armorgames.com], blocked
  `_ -RI` [mofunzone.com, miniclips.biz, solidgames.com] (Main.as:293-316; GameData.as:185-203).
- `addEventListener(Event.ENTER_FRAME, this.Run)` then `LoadOtherGameData()` (settings load), `LoadAllData()` (profile load); FPS meter only if `gData._-7Y` (false in release, GameData.as:165) (Main.as:372-378).
- `arrMenuNavigation = [-1]`, `arrUserData = ["","",false]` (Main.as:379-381).

### 2.3 Settings load (`LoadOtherGameData`, Main.as:634-758)

SharedObject `"BTA"` defaults written on first run: `q = StageQuality.HIGH`, `s = true` (sounds),

(87, 83, 65, 68, 80, 81 — W/S/A/D/P/Q; GameData.as:158-163), `arrLocalRatings = []`, `assr = []`, `la = []`.
